title: Kauffman bracket state sum and the Jones polynomial

items.title: Kauffman bracket smoothing and loop value
items.statement: Defines the Kauffman bracket of a nonempty unoriented regular diagram by its finite state sum, with loop value δ = −A² − A⁻² and the KT-29 source crossing chart.
items.strategy: Proves the state set is finite, every loop exponent is nonnegative, and planar isotopy reindexes the same state sum.

items.title: Kauffman bracket state sum
items.statement: Traverses every A/B state of a typed nonempty finite unoriented regular diagram and returns the Laurent polynomial given by the Kauffman bracket state sum.
items.strategy: Uses the finite crossing set to enumerate exactly 2^c states and accumulates each prescribed Laurent-polynomial term.

items.title: Kauffman bracket R2 and R3 identities
items.statement: Proves the local Temperley–Lieb crossing operators cancel under R2 and satisfy the three-strand braid relation under R3 at loop value δ = −A² − A⁻².
items.strategy: Identifies the fixed source-chart smoothings with the through and cup-cap diagrams, then expands both local products using the diagram-generator relations.

items.title: Kauffman bracket state-sum procedure properties
items.statement: On every typed nonempty finite unoriented regular diagram, the state-sum procedure terminates and returns exactly the finite Laurent polynomial specified by the algorithm.
items.strategy: The finite crossing set gives a finite state set; every update is a Laurent-polynomial operation and the loop visits each state once.

items.title: Kauffman bracket curl and writhe correction
items.statement: Positive and negative type-I kinks multiply the raw bracket by −A³ and −A⁻³, respectively; the factor (−A³)⁻ʷ cancels type-I changes and preserves the type-II and type-III bracket invariance.
items.strategy: Resolves each curl into its straight-arc and one-circle states, evaluates both factors, and checks the writhe exponent change for each Reidemeister type.

items.title: Hecke–bracket trace dictionary and local descent
items.statement: Under the explicit q, A and t parameter dictionary, each braid-closure bracket equals the specialized Hecke/Ocneanu trace expression, with unknot normalization and both stabilization factors verified.
items.strategy: Identifies the bracket crossing representation with a rescaled Hecke generator, proves the normalized diagram closure trace has the specialized Markov rules, and derives uniqueness after specialization from the free tower decomposition.

items.title: The normalized bracket is an oriented link invariant
items.statement: For a nonempty oriented link diagram D, f_D(A) = (−A³)⁻ʷʳ(D)⟨D⟩ is unchanged by planar isotopy and every oriented Reidemeister move, hence depends only on the ambient-isotopy class of the oriented link.
items.strategy: The local bracket lemmas prove invariance under each move, and the oriented Reidemeister theorem converts ambient isotopy into a finite move sequence under ACω.

items.title: The bracket state sum matches the library Jones specialization
items.statement: For every nonempty oriented link K, the bracket invariant satisfies V_K(t) = f_K(t⁻¹/⁴) in the library’s Hecke-trace convention.
items.strategy: The trace dictionary gives equality on braid closures; the bracket and Hecke-trace invariance theorems and Alexander’s braid-closure theorem extend it to every nonempty oriented link.

title: Kauffman bracket state sum and the Jones polynomial — Examples and Counterexamples

items.title: A type-I kink changes the raw bracket
items.statement: An R1 kink multiplies the raw bracket by −A³ or −A⁻³, so the raw bracket is not an invariant of unframed ambient isotopy.
items.strategy: Compares the bracket of a crossing-free unknot diagram with that of the diagram after a positive kink using the curl factor.

items.title: Trefoil, mirror, and unknot bracket calculations
items.statement: The positive trefoil has Jones polynomial t + t³ − t⁴, its mirror has t⁻¹ + t⁻³ − t⁻⁴, and the unknot has value 1 in the declared convention.
items.strategy: Lists and evaluates all eight states of the closure of the positive two-strand three-crossing braid, then applies writhe normalization and the mirror substitution.
